composition_label: Semantic search -> Journey recommendations -> Sentiment & prioritization

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory, using explicitly synthetic fixtures.

input.fixture_label: Nonblank string; example explicitly labeled SYNTHETIC.
input.products: Array of {id, name, description, tags: unique nonblank string array}.
input.actions: Array of {id, product_id, title, requires: unique action ID array, interest}.
input.profile: {completed_actions: unique action ID array, interests: unique string array}. Completed history must include prerequisites.
input.feedback: Array of {id, product_id, action_id: nullable action ID, text, severity: low|medium|high|critical}.

output.success: {status: ok, schema_version: 1, fixture_label, semantic, journey, sentiment}
output.journey: {source_product_ids, next_actions, status: ready|unavailable, steps, reason}. Steps contain action_id, product_id, requires, interest_match.
output.sentiment: {source_action_ids, issues, excluded_feedback_count}. Issues contain feedback_id, product_id, action_id, severity, priority and sentiment {score, label, evidence}.
output.error: {status: error, error: message}; CLI exit code 2.

shared_schema.validation: One validate boundary checks strict input shapes, types, uniqueness, references, DAG acyclicity and completed history; validates ranked search output and provenance; recomputes canonical journey and sentiment results to reject tampered handoffs. Unknown input fields and duplicate JSON object keys are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs.contract: Validated ranked hit product IDs restrict candidate actions and provide primary recommendation order; profile interests break within-product ties. Existing completed prerequisites may be outside retrieved products.

Only feedback for products on the validated two-step journey is scored. Action-specific feedback must match a selected step; product-wide feedback is included once. No feasible journey means no included issues.

behavior.search: In-memory inverted index with lowercase ASCII tokenization, explicit synonym canonicalization and normalized TF-IDF cosine relevance. Default search is deterministic and local; it is not a learned semantic model. Zero-score hits omitted; descending score then ascending product ID; scores rounded to eight decimal places.
behavior.embedding: Optional run(payload, embedding=callable) API; callable maps a query or product name plus description to a list/tuple of 1..4096 finite numbers, with finite nonzero norm and consistent dimensions. Blend 50% lexical cosine and 50% nonnegative embedding cosine. Callable failures become ValidationError; fixtures only, no provider.
behavior.journey: Prerequisite-ready uncompleted next actions ordered by search rank, interest match and action ID. Look ahead across ready first actions for a feasible distinct second action. Exactly two validated steps or explicit unavailable state; no fabricated steps or prerequisites.
behavior.sentiment: Explicit lexicon weights: love/great +2, good/helpful +1, bad/confusing/slow -1, broken/hate -2. Immediately preceding not/never/no flips a matched token. Score is signed weight sum divided by absolute weight sum; no matches are neutral. Evidence exposes token, position, negation and applied weight.
behavior.priority: 100 * severity ordinal (low=1, medium=2, high=3, critical=4) + 10 * max(0, -sentiment score). Severity always dominates sentiment, including critical issues with positive text. Descending priority then feedback ID.
behavior.cli: One JSON object on stdout, exit 0 on success. Usage, input validation, encoding, JSON and file errors produce one JSON error object, exit 2. No network configuration, logging to stdout or file writes by the implementation.
behavior.determinism: Built-in pipeline is deterministic and does not mutate input. An injected callable must itself be deterministic.

included: Integrated three-stage pipeline with shared schema and validated provenance
Local relevance index and optional validated embedding callable
Prerequisite-aware two-step journey with explicit unavailability
Transparent sentiment evidence and severity-first issue ordering
Synthetic fixture data, CLI, unit and subprocess tests
excluded: Live providers, networks, training, learned embeddings or persistent indexes
Enterprise authentication, databases, service deployment and production scale
General natural-language understanding, sarcasm and multilingual sentiment
Automatically executing recommended actions or modifying completed history
scope.auxiliary_artifacts: docs\My_prompt.txt is the required prompt audit log, separate from the four implementation deliverables.

test_outcomes.verified_handoff: camera -> setup, shoot -> feedback f2, f1, f3 ordered by priority
coverage: Synonyms, inverted index, ranking and stable ties
Injected deterministic embeddings, invalid vectors, dimensions and callable failures
Personalization, prerequisites, completed history and cross-product dependencies
No match, empty catalog and insufficient journey steps
Sentiment negation, neutral evidence and severity dominance
Cross-stage propagation, feedback filtering and tampered handoff rejection
Invalid input, duplicate IDs, cycles, missing references and action/product mismatches
Input immutability; subprocess CLI success, missing-file and usage errors
CLI malformed JSON, invalid schema, duplicate keys and nonfinite constants
